  const heroSection = document.querySelector('.hero');
  const heroShapes = document.querySelector('.hero-shapes');
  const heroGlow = document.querySelector('.hero-glow');
  const particles = document.querySelectorAll('.particle');
  
  if (heroSection && (heroShapes || heroGlow || particles.length)) {
    let rafId = null;
    
    function handleParallax() {
      const scrolled = window.pageYOffset;
      const rate = scrolled * 0.3;
      
      if (heroShapes) {
        heroShapes.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (rate * 0.5) + 'px)';
      }
      if (heroGlow) {
        heroGlow.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (rate * 0.3) + 'px)';
      }
      
      rafId = null;
    }
    
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
      if (!rafId) {
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(handleParallax);
      }
    });
  }
  
  // =============== MARQUEE PAUSE ON HOVER ===============
  const marqueeTrack = document.querySelector('.marquee-track');
  
  if (marqueeTrack) {
    marqueeTrack.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {

      const rect = this.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      
      const ripple = document.createElement('span');
      ripple.style.cssText = `
        position: absolute;
        width: 100px;
        height: 100px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
        border-radius: 50%;
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0);
        animation: ripple 0.6s linear;
        left: ${x}px;
        top: ${y}px;
        pointer-events: none;
      `;
      
      this.style.position = 'relative';
      this.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      this.appendChild(ripple);
      
      setTimeout(function() {
        ripple.remove();
      }, 600);
    });
  });

  const style = document.createElement('style');

  // =============== TYPING EFFECT FOR HERO TEXT ===============

        }, index * 100);
        staggerObserver.unobserve(entry.target);

  }, { threshold: 0.1 });

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  const tabs = document.querySelectorAll(".why-tab");
  if (!tabs.length) return;

  let currentIndex = 0;
  const intervalTime = 5000; // 5 seconds
  let autoTabInterval;

  function activateTab(index) {
    tabs.forEach(tab => tab.classList.remove("active"));
    tabs[index].classList.add("active");

    // Trigger existing click logic (VERY IMPORTANT)
    tabs[index].click();

    currentIndex = index;
  }

  function startAutoTabs() {
    autoTabInterval = setInterval(() => {
      let nextIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % tabs.length;
      activateTab(nextIndex);
    }, intervalTime);
  }

  function resetAutoTabs(index) {
    clearInterval(autoTabInterval);
    activateTab(index);
    startAutoTabs();
  }

  // Allow manual click without breaking auto-rotation
  tabs.forEach((tab, index) => {
    tab.addEventListener("click", () => {
      currentIndex = index;
      clearInterval(autoTabInterval);
      startAutoTabs();
    });
  });

  // Init
  startAutoTabs();

});

@keyframes gentle-float {

  50% { transform: translateY(-55%) translateX(3px); }

  50% { opacity: 0.4; }

  position: absolute;
  bottom: 2rem;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);

  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;

  border-radius: 13px;
  position: relative;
}

.wheel {
  width: 4px;
  height: 8px;
  background: var(--emerald-400);
  border-radius: 2px;
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  animation: scroll-wheel 1.5s infinite;
}

@keyframes scroll-wheel {

  100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(10px); }

.scroll-indicator span {

    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(-50px);

  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(0);

}

.animate-slide-in-right {

    transform: translateX(50px);

  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(0);

  transform: translateX(0);
  opacity: 1;
}

.slide-in-right {

  opacity: 0;
  transition: all 0.6s ease-out;

.slide-in-right.visible {
